_note: The element physics every world obeys (src/combat/element_rules.gd; read by the crypt game src/game.gd + src/combat/elements.gd + src/combat/boss_moves.gd and by the story worlds src/hell/hell_game.gd + src/hell/hell_monsters.gd). User decision 2026-10-31: everything that stands in a material feels it, hero and monster alike, in every chapter; only a creature of that element is spared (its tags, see actor_tags). Units: px are crypt world px (the story worlds scale by their art px, 1.5x); hurt = half hearts the hero loses per tick; enemy_hurt = hero hits per second a monster loses (the crypt: damage points per second); tick = s between hero ticks; slow = share of walking speed left (1 = none); grip = share of the momentum left after one second on it (0.015 = glaze ice, 1 = firm ground); status = {kind: [value, seconds]} put on whoever stands in it every frame (so it lingers that long after leaving: lava keeps burning); immune = tags of creatures that feel nothing of it; douse = puts out burning; conducts = lightning charges it; priority = which material counts where pools overlap (first wins). why = what the hero reads when it hurts him.
_gases_note: Gas on the floor (src/vfx/gas.gd clouds): what breathing it does. vision = how far the view closes while inside (0 none, 1 only the cloud itself stays visible); blind_shots = s a monster in it cannot shoot; dense_from = the cloud's thickness (0..1) from which it counts as standing in it.
_vision_note: The view inside gas (src/hero/story_glow.gd frame, src/dungeon_view.gd _update_darkness): the world outside the cloud goes dark, only the cloud around the hero stays. dark = darkness strength at full vision loss; min_radius / max_radius = px the view keeps at least / at most; fade_in / fade_out = s the dark closes in and opens again; probe_hz = how often a second the cloud's reach is measured; thin = cloud thickness below which a ray is out of it.
_reactions_note: What meets what (src/combat/elements.gd in the crypt game, src/hell/hell_monsters.gd in the story worlds; the crypt's own values in src/data/balance.json element win there). Fire on poison (pool or gas) explodes: explode_damage to enemies within the poison radius + explode_reach px, setting off poison next to it up to explode_chain times. Frost on water: Glatteis for ice_time s; fire thaws it. Fire or lava on water: steam (radius x steam_scale, steam_time s). Water touching lava: the lava is harmless for crust_time s. Frost on steam: it condenses, the steam falls as water (rain_scale of its radius). explode_hits = hero hits the blast deals to a monster in the story worlds (the crypt game uses explode_damage).
_actor_tags_note: Which creature is of which element: a tag per word in its id or kind (the story defs add their shot element and material: assets/data/krypta_monsters.json; every hell monster is of the hell: fire and lava do nothing to it). undead = no breath, no blood: poison does nothing.
_combos_note: What a creature's own condition does with the medium it meets (src/combat/elements.gd and src/hell/hell_game.gd / hell_monsters.gd): a burning creature walking into poison (pool or gas) sets it off (explode_r = px of fire round it); a wet creature cannot be set burning (water on the skin), and frost gas or ice freezes it solid for freeze_wet s (bosses never).
_breath_gas_note: The gas a breath or cone of an element leaves hanging (src/vfx/gas.gd materials): poison and frost their own, fire and lava smoke; none for bone, gold or souls. breath_r = share of the breath's reach the cloud is wide, breath_time = s it hangs.
hurt_note: hurt: half hearts per second for the hero, drained continuously onto the life bar (src/hell/hell_game.gd dot_hurt_f; the crypt accumulates whole points, src/combat/elements.gd dot_f); enemy_hurt: hero hits per second on a monster, landed every tick s. status values: burn/poison in half hearts per second, slow/wet/slip/silence as before.

swallow._note: The void swallows what lies near it (user decision 2026-10-31): a void puddle, a Singularität or a boss vortex pulls other puddles and gas clouds within reach x its radius into itself and eats them. time: s a swallowed puddle takes to drain; pull: px/s gas puffs stream inward; thin: gas density lost per second inside; motes: void motes per second streaming from a swallowed puddle to the centre; gulp: s between gulps of the centre (a small void burst).
